pricing._note: Every hoodie uses this price. compareAt shows struck through; the discount badge is calculated from the two (rounded down).

note.ar: مقاسات تقريبية لقصة Oversized، مقاسة والقطعة مفرودة. هتتحدّث بمقاسات المورد النهائية.
note.en: Approximate measurements for an oversized fit, taken flat. Will be updated with the supplier's final spec.

_images: Every design on the real studio hoodie photos (very light Ivory studio, 4:5), only the sides that are printed: back, front, plus one print close-up (detail, best colour). Paths: assets/products/<id>/<colour>-<front|back>-<width>.webp, detail-<width>.webp
_printAreas: Print areas (% of the 4:5 mockup canvas + real size on size L), measured from the owner's reference (2026-10-21). The chest box is picked from the art's shape: wide logo or small/square logo.

front.note: wide chest logo: centred, 60-65% of the body width, ends above the pocket

frontSmall.note: small / square chest logo: same top line, centred

back.note: centred, 85-90% of the body width; art fitted with contain (never stretched or cropped), top-aligned

_placement: 2026-10-21, measured from the owner's reference (One Piece 1.png) and mapped by garment landmarks: same real sizes on the 4:5 light-Ivory mockups (2026-10-24): front wide logo 30.9% of the canvas (~26-28 cm), top 34.5%, ends above the pocket; front small/square logo max 10 cm, same top line; back max 59.1% x 41.8% of the canvas (~32-35 x 38-40 cm), top 32% (just under the hood). Fit = contain, centred, top-aligned. No front file = back only (no front/back switch).
_cards: The card shows the first printed side (back when there is a back print, else the front); desktop hover / phone swipe shows the other printed side.
